purpose: Exercise the statistics-expression branch absent from Census and falsify plain stxkeys-only disjointness.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE expr_probe(a int, b int, t text)
CREATE STATISTICS expr_a (mcv) ON a, lower(t) FROM expr_probe
CREATE STATISTICS expr_b (mcv) ON b, lower(t) FROM expr_probe
SELECT * FROM expr_probe WHERE a=1 AND b=1 AND lower(t)='x'

source_derived_result.a_then_b: a consumes a=1 and lower(t)='x'; b retains only b=1 and is no longer MCV-eligible
source_derived_result.b_then_a: b consumes b=1 and lower(t)='x'; a retains only a=1 and is no longer MCV-eligible

evidence_type: Constructed directly from PostgreSQL 16.14 statext expression matching and consumption semantics; not counted among Census runtime instances.
conclusion: Disjoint pg_statistic_ext.stxkeys alone is not sufficient when statistics expressions are admitted. Full key dimensions or compatible/consumed clause scopes must include expressions.
